test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which one of the following is not a hardware component of a computer?
solution:
__**Memory**__ is NOT correct.

__
 
• **Memory is not a hardware component of a computer**__.
 
• Computer hardware includes the physical parts of a computer, such as a case, **central processing unit (CPU), random access memory (RAM), monitor, mouse, keyboard, computer data storage, graphics card, sound card, speakers, and motherboard**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Input Device: **A piece of equipment/hardware that helps us to enter data into a computer is called an input device. For example keyboard, mouse etc.
 
• **Output Device: **A piece of equipment/hardware that returns the result of the input entered, once processed (i.e. converts data from machine language into human-understandable language), is called an output device. For example printers, monitors, etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Software **is a collection of instructions that tell a computer how to work.

 
 
• This is in contrast to the hardware from which the system is built and which actually works.
 
• Some examples of commonly used application software include **Web browsers, Word processors, Multimedia software, Spreadsheet software, Email clients, and Graphics software**.
